text:
Mike: noticed a 20-30% p90 latency regression on prod serving after yesterday's matmul heuristic change. load test job 24709 shows weird midbatch tail.
Sophia: yikes. which commit? do we have an nsys trace?
Mike: commit b7f3d1e - small PR that changed workspace sizing heuristic (min_ws -> 0.6x). I ran an nsys snapshot on a repro run: link: https://internal.nsys/trace/24709
Kai: quick skim of the trace: kernels look different. cuBLASLt switched algos mid-run. I see repeated fallbacks from algo 10 -> algo 3 with larger launch times. timeline shows extra <kernel> stalls around mempool allocs.
Mike: here's the exact nsys capture command I used:
```bash
nsys profile -o matmul_regress --trace=cupti,cuda,osrt --sample=none --cpuctxsw --gpu-metrics-device=0 --duration=30s ./serve_load_test --workload=consolidated
```
Sophia: can you paste the kernel table (nsys export) snippet? curious about workspace bytes reported.
Kai: pasted top lines from the nsys kernel summary:
```
cuBlasLtMatmul_kernel_1  elapsed  1.84ms   workspace_bytes=0
cuBlasLtMatmul_kernel_2  elapsed  4.12ms   workspace_bytes=524288
cuBlasLtMatmul_kernel_3  elapsed  2.09ms   workspace_bytes=0
```
Kai: looks like when workspace_bytes==0 cuBLASLt is using a fallback algo with worse perf. That matches the algo ID flip.
Anita: that's consistent with the heuristic change — we reduced requested workspace threshold to squeeze memory, but for some shapes it forces workspace-less algorithms.
Mike: also seeing KV cache warmup spikes in the same windows. midbatch evict sampler kicks in and causes mempool churn.
Sophia: screenshot from perfetto: https://internal.perfetto/trace/24709 perfetto shows alloc/free bursts at 120ms intervals overlapping matmul spikes.
Kai: hypothesis: the new min_ws broke the allocator pre-reservation for cuBLASLt, causing both fallback algo selection and extra cudaMallocAsync pressure -> serialization
Anita: quick repro suggestion: force the runtime to preallocate a small slab for cuBLASLt and re-run the load. if p90 improves, we confirm.
Mike: I ran a quick patch locally toggling prealloc to 1MB for matmul contexts. p90 dropped from 143ms -> 106ms on same synthetic workload.
perf-bot: perf CI: job/serve-load/b7f3d1e shows +18% p90 vs baseline. tagged regression. link: https://ci.internal/job/serve-load/24709
Sophia: good catch. action items:
- revert heuristic change OR add a matmul-exception that keeps min_ws >= shape-specific floor (Anita)
- add unit to validate cuBLASLt algo selection in sampler CI (Kai)
- add a mempool fragmentation test to nightly (Mike)
- instrument runtime to emit "matmul_ws_requested" metric and a counter for algo-fallbacks (Sophia)
Anita: I'll draft the exception: map common shapes -> safe_min_ws and ship hotfix toggle.
Kai: I'll add an nsys smoke test to CI that asserts no fallback-algo-for-major-shapes and checks workspace_bytes > 0 for those shapes. Also add a perfetto capture snippet for easier triage.
Mike: thanks. leaving notes on the trace with timeline timestamps where spikes start: 00:00:12.3, 00:00:24.8, 00:00:37.1
Sophia: reassigning to eng-runtime oncall to roll the toggle if we see more regressions. :eyes:
Mike: will follow up with detailed repro steps and attach the raw nsys export.
Anita: cc @lead-runtime - if we want immediate rollback, ping me.
perf-bot: benchmark snapshot: baseline p90=89ms, current p90=105ms, with prealloc p90=92ms.
